relevanceRule: A held-out item is relevant only if it is a real RATE with rating >= 4. Simulated borrows stay in training and never count as relevant.
coldStartDefinition: fewer than coldStartThreshold distinct books in training
evaluatedPatrons: patrons with at least one relevant held-out book

hybridOptions.normalisation: A: min-max per patron over their candidates (0 if no spread); B: clamp to [1, 5] then (B - 1) / 4; a candidate with no CF prediction contributes 0 from CF
hybridOptions.attribution: CONTENT if contentWeight*A_norm >= collabWeight*B_norm, else COLLABORATIVE; cold-path items are CONTENT

coverageDefinition: share of evaluated patrons receiving 0, 1..N-1 or N recommendations; no backfilling
supplementary: *Covered metrics average P/R/F1 over only the patrons who received at least one recommendation; they are reported apart from the headline numbers. contentShare/collabShare: share of recommended items attributed to each component (hybrid only).
